authorization_scope: single DATA-only exploratory execution; execution authorization is not human scientific review
design_rationale: The predecessor produced exact equality between closed_loop and exact yoked_replay on all 20 paired seeds. V3 therefore changes only temporal alignment of the same perturbation-exposed donor sensor content. Circular temporal shifts preserve the donor sensor-value multiset while breaking tick alignment. This is an exploratory causal-timing ablation, not a confirmatory rescue of H-EMB-001-B.

design.content_preservation_rule: shifted donor tape must contain exactly the same sensor-pair multiset as the exact donor tape

analysis_plan.direction_convention: positive control-minus-closed_loop difference means lower error in closed_loop
report: fraction of paired seeds with lower closed_loop error

integrity_requirements: same initial neural state within each seed
same initial body state within each seed
same graph fingerprint within each seed
exact yoked donor digest equals the actual perturbed closed-loop sensor digest for that seed
shifted donor tapes preserve the exact donor sensor-value multiset
shift20 and shift100 donor digests differ from the exact donor digest
feedback_absent observed sensor values are exactly zero
identical registered perturbation schedule for all arms
stopping_rule: Execute exactly the preregistered 20 seeds and five conditions. Retain failures; no replacement seeds and no outcome-dependent stopping.
claim_boundary: This is prospective exploratory synthetic DATA testing temporal alignment within the scoped H-EMB-001-B programme. It is not confirmatory EVID, not independent replication, not evidence of learned body schema, autonomy, consciousness, biological equivalence, real-device transfer, or 5D superiority. Human Review remains required.
